notes: The tape's d.ents digest exercises every watched value through each kind's writeEntityToNBT, so the state half is gated even though the wire half is absent. id 16's meaning differs per kind (pig saddle, sheep colour, spider climb, creeper state, ghast charge, slime size) and each keeps its own field or bit. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): wire format and connection plumbing: native messages are structs by design (SPEC: messages are structs, not bytes). Formerly listed as missing: The packet wire format (writeWatchedListToPacketBuffer, func_151509_a, writeWatchableObjectToPacketBuffer, readWatchedListFromPacketBuffer, updateWatchedObjectsFromList): the native replay never serializes entity metadata packets.
